summary: Iter 33 — Frontend regression validation of the LoginPage refactor (1960→257 line orchestrator + /auth/ subcomponents). 8/9 explicit test items PASS as-implemented. One test item (item #4 'Branded /surirent/login on DESKTOP shows the PIN-pad') is technically not the default view on desktop — but this is INTENTIONAL preserved behavior from before the refactor (PinLogin component contains a code comment: 'Desktop default: skip PIN keypad and show email login form directly. Mobile keeps PIN-first flow'). The PIN-pad is fully functional and reachable via the 'Terug naar PIN' link; PIN 1234 successfully calls /api/auth/kiosk-pin and navigates to /surirent/kiosk. All other refactor flows (generic /login email card, forgot-password modal, admin login → /admin, /login?register=1 → / with modal, marketing topbar Registreren, full register-modal create-company flow with success screen, and QR-code tab) work identically to pre-refactor.

issues: Branded portal default-view on desktop is the email-form, NOT the PIN-pad. This matches the explicit code intent (comment in LoginPage.jsx lines 34-40) and was the same before the refactor — but the testing request item #4 expects the PIN-pad as the default. If the desired UX is PIN-first on branded URLs even on desktop, remove the `window.innerWidth >= 1024` desktop short-circuit on the branded code-path (it should only apply when there is no branding.slug). On mobile (< 1024px) PIN-pad is the default as expected. PIN flow itself works perfectly when shown.

rca_of_the_issue: Test item #4 (branded /surirent/login should show PIN-pad on desktop) does not match current implementation because LoginPage.jsx initialView() unconditionally returns 'login' (email-form) when window.innerWidth >= 1024, regardless of branding.slug. This is intentional and pre-existing — the comment in code says 'Desktop default: skip PIN keypad and show email login form directly. Mobile keeps PIN-first flow (more tactile + branded).' If product wants PIN-first on branded desktop, the condition `if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) return 'login';` should be guarded by `&& !brandingSlugDetected` or the early-detected slug. No code fix applied because the refactor was explicitly required to be functionally identical to before — preserving this default is correct refactor behavior.
